pattern: Generated cards look swollen on this vector. Boxes become soft pillows, and tubes, fins and ropes get fat, with tight corners and thin rails or struts lost. Real cards keep slimmer parts and flat faces. The pairs differ only slightly, so most calls are low confidence.
